{{Top|leg}}
An '''immunity sphere''' referred to territory during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] where the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was not allowed to enter by the people within that territory, usually with a tax and possibly other favors to maintain the sphere in return. A notable example of an immunity sphere was [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]], where administrator [[Simon Greyshade/Legends|Simon Greyshade]] maintained it under the condition that he pay taxes to the Empire and have an anti-alien bias on the Wheel's patrons.

Another possible example of an immunity sphere was the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and by extension the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], as the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] official field guide, the [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|''Imperial Handbook'']], mentioned that the Corporate Sector was largely established to allow for corporate competition with no interference from even the Empire and implied that this was the reason it had a booming economy.<ref name="IHB">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
